sentences.text:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Shri S.A.Mohta, Advocate for petitioner.
 Ms. N.P.Mehta, Assistant Government Pleader for respondent Nos. 1 & 2.
 Coram : R. K. Deshpande &
 Vinay Joshi, Jj.
Date : 11.02.2019.
Issue notice to the respondents for final disposal of the matter returnable on 08.04.2019.
The learned Assistant Government Pleader waives service of notice to the respondent Nos. 1 and 2.

The challenge in this petition is to the order dated 20.07.2018 issued by the Commissioner of Food Safety imposing ban on manufacturing, storage, distribution, transport or sale of tobacco which is either flavoured, scented or mixed with any of the said additives.

The challenge is on the ground of lack of jurisdiction because Chewing Tobacco is listed as food Item No. 40 in Table under Sub-regulation 2.3.1 of the Food Safety and Standard (Contaminates, Toxins and Residues)
Regulation, 2011.

entities.text:
Food Safety and Standard (Contaminates, Toxins and Residues)
Regulation, 2011
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The item of chewing tobacco has been deleted by the Notification in the Gazette of India issued on 19.03.2018 and without notice of it, the ban in question is imposed in terms of Section 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and Rules and Regulations 2011.
We direct the respondent No.2, Commissioner to consider this aspect of the matter and file an affidavit on or before 08.04.2019.
JUDGE JUDGE Shyamsundar S/O Baijnath Bhartiya vs State Of Maharashtra, Thr. Principal ...
